description:
Real-time monitoring dashboard for BambuLab 3D printers.
Tracks printer health, print progress, temperatures, fan speeds,
AMS filament inventory, and queue status via Prometheus metrics.
Supports multiple printers and AMS units automatically.

panels.title: Printer Connection
panels.description: Live MQTT connection to the printer. Other panels keep showing the last values received while this reads Disconnected.

panels.title: Job State
panels.description: Job phase from recent firmware, finer than Printer State.

panels.title: Top Lid
panels.description: Top lid sensor. H2 family only; other models show N/A.
Spaghetti Detector
panels.title: Ai Monitor

panels.description: Halt printing sensitivity
panels.title: Ai Monitor Sensitivity
Camera Recording
panels.description: Whether the printer camera is recording.

panels.title: Timelapse
panels.description: Whether timelapse recording is on for prints.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Wired (Ethernet) or Wi-Fi connection.

panels.title: Stage Countdown
panels.description: Time left in the current stage, for example thermal preconditioning. 0 when no countdown runs.

panels.title: Skipped Objects
panels.description: Objects skipped in the current print.

panels.title: File Download
panels.description: Download progress of the job file before the print starts.

panels.title: Job Source
panels.description: Where the current job came from.

panels.title: Speed
panels.description: Print speed as a percentage of normal, next to the speed profile.

panels.title: Fail Reason
panels.description: Reason code reported when a print fails. Empty when the print has not failed.

targets.expr: (max(bambulab_printer_model_info{job="$job", printer_name="$printer", model=~"H.*"} == 1) * 350) or (max(bambulab_printer_model_info{job="$job", printer_name="$printer", model="X1E"} == 1) * 320) or (max(bambulab_printer_model_info{job="$job", printer_name="$printer"} == 1) * 300)

panels.title: Nozzle Temperature (C)
panels.description: Active nozzle temperature. The scale ends at the model's nozzle limit: 350 °C on H models (H2 family, H3C), 320 °C on the X1E, 300 °C on other models.

panels.title: Nozzle Temperatures per Extruder
panels.description: Current (solid) and target (dashed) temperature of each nozzle. Extruder 0 is the right nozzle, extruder 1 the left on dual-nozzle printers.

panels.title: Extruder Status
panels.description: Per extruder: filament change step, feed direction, filament sensor, loaded AMS slot, nozzle and buffer. Extruder 0 is the right nozzle and 1 the left on dual-nozzle printers. Older printers show only the columns they report.

targets.expr: max by (extruder_id, slot) (label_replace(label_replace(label_join(bambulab_extruder_loaded_slot_info{job="$job", printer_name="$printer"} == 1, "slot", " slot ", "ams_id", "slot_id"), "slot", "AMS $1", "slot", "([0-9]+ slot .+)"), "slot", "External spool", "ams_id", "external"))

push_switcher_filament.text: Feeding at the Filament Track Switch

pull_switcher_filament.text: Pulling back at the Filament Track Switch

panels.title: Active Nozzle
panels.description: Nozzle in use on dual-nozzle printers. Extruder 0 is the right nozzle, extruder 1 the left.

panels.title: Active Nozzle Type
panels.description: Type code and diameter of the nozzle in use.

panels.title: Nozzle Wear
panels.description: Raw wear value reported by the printer; the unit is not confirmed.

panels.title: Spools in AMS
panels.description: Slots with a spool, with or without an RFID tag. AMS, AMS lite, AMS 2 Pro and AMS HT only.

panels.title: Drying Phase
panels.description: What the dryer is doing: heating or dehumidifying.

panels.title: Drying Duration
panels.description: Drying time set for the current or last drying run.

panels.title: Drying Blocked
panels.description: Why drying cannot start now. drying_in_progress only means a run is active.

panels.title: HMS Errors by Severity
panels.description: Active HMS (health management) errors. Details are on the printer screen.

panels.title: Firmware Upgrade
panels.description: Firmware upgrade progress reported by the printer.

panels.title: Printer Connection
panels.description: 1 while the exporter holds a live MQTT connection to the printer.

panels.title: Exporter Poll
panels.description: Whether the exporter's latest polling cycle succeeded.

panels.title: Last Successful Poll
panels.description: Time since the exporter last completed a polling cycle.

panels.title: Poll Duration
panels.description: How long each polling cycle takes.
